### 2026-11-08: # schematic design

**2h**

# schematic design

found cool mcu with native usb connector(esp32-s3-mini-1). would have liked to use c-series cause risc-v but... it's fine...

![piece](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/Enz5eN54l9lqazRN1RmXsVG67e54hcBG/0d33540882ae4ed780491963006d5859e8a7e98bee07c2afd7ed1eb2c21577d6.png)

worked on organizing left and right schematics seperately.

here i ran into issue where i had them in hierarchical sheets at first. but then my dumb brain
 thought i couldn't have them on different pcbs. i could have just used the two edge cuts, looking back in retrospect. in the end i made seperate schematics and pcbs. ugh,... this will probably make pcb ordering more expensive...

# finished schematic. head hurts...

### 2026-11-08: # pcb time

**3h**

# pcb time

moved from schematic design to pcb, assigned footprints.

i found out u can space the grid to be 19.05mm exactly. but that was beign weird and not having the keys line up at all so i ended up making it in a 1/8ths grid spacing.

routing the pcb was the most relaxing part.
